description: This file defines an immutable implementation of the Permissions interface, providing methods to create, check, and serialize permissions sets. It includes static factory methods for creating Permissions instances and overrides collection methods to enforce immutability.

classes.name: ImmutablePermissions
classes.description: Immutable implementation of Permissions, representing a set of permission strings with methods for creation, containment checking, serialization, and immutability enforcement.

methods.name: of
methods.description: Creates a permissions set from a mandatory permission and optional additional permissions.

methods.name: of
methods.description: Creates a permissions set from a collection of permission strings.

methods.name: contains
methods.description: Checks if the permissions set contains a specific permission, optionally with additional permissions.

methods.name: contains
methods.description: Checks if the permissions set contains all permissions from another Permissions instance.

methods.name: size
methods.description: Returns the number of permissions in the set.

methods.name: toJson
methods.description: Serializes the permissions set to a JsonArray.
